reply.failure_summary: The click on #submit-btn timed out: no element has that id any more.
reply.hypothesis: The submit button is still on the page and still named Submit; only its id is gone. Finding it by role and name matches what the user sees.
reply.confidence_rationale: The page snapshot at the failure shows exactly one button named Submit, and the error names the missing selector.
reasoning_steps: The error is a timeout waiting for locator('#submit-btn').
The page snapshot at the failure shows the form with the name filled in and a button named "Submit".
Nothing in the snapshot carries the id submit-btn, so the selector drifted.
getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit' }) finds the same button by what the user sees.
root_cause_evidence: button "Submit" in the page snapshot at the failure

action_taken.description: Find the submit button by its role and name instead of the removed id.
